title: No Nether Mob Zombification (Simple)
description: A simple mod that prevents Nether pigs from becoming zombies
body: Have you ever felt like you wanted to organize an uprising of the hellish pigs against the Overworld? Did the vanilla mechanics of zombification of piglins hinder you in this? This simple mod will make your Nether pigs invulnerable to airborne zombie viruses, COVID-19, chickenpox, colds, [insert random disease] and more.
